user.title: Untappd
user.description:
Untappd closed its public API, so this reads your Untappd pages.

**Username only:** your public profile (stats and recent check-ins). The profile must be public.

**Optional session cookie:** adds beer-history statistics (average rating, top styles and breweries, strongest beer and more). Untappd's login page uses a CAPTCHA, so the integration cannot sign in for you. Sign in to untappd.com in your browser, open developer tools > Network, click any untappd.com request and copy the `Cookie` request header. Also paste your browser's `User-Agent` if requests get blocked. The cookie is stored in your Home Assistant config and expires eventually; you will be asked for a new one.

reauth_confirm.title: Untappd session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The Untappd session for {username} is missing or expired. Sign in to untappd.com in your browser and paste the `Cookie` request header again.

error.user_not_found: No Untappd user with that name.
error.profile_unreadable: The profile could not be read. It may be private, or Untappd changed its page.
error.invalid_auth: That cookie was rejected. Make sure you are signed in and copy the full Cookie header.
error.beer_history_unreadable: Signed in, but the beer history page could not be read. Untappd may be blocking the request; try pasting your browser's User-Agent too.

abort.already_configured: This Untappd user is already configured.

init.description: Untappd pages are cached for hours, so keep intervals gentle. The faster interval applies only inside the happy-hour window, which may cross midnight. Set both intervals equal to turn this off.
